circuit: 67482db6c538 (yoyobar, with Ahmed Berat Özer's patch; on busyaprime's 9a8627 and mrmeows' design)

stages.title: Normalize the input
stages.desc: Counts the leading zeros of x with an AND chain over the inverted bits and encodes the count in five control qubits (q42..q46). CSWAP ladders controlled by those bits reverse/shift the x register into a normalized mantissa; the prefix flags and count bits are then erased by X-basis measurement with CZ phase repairs. Identical, op for op, to 9a8627.

stages.title: Coefficient table lookup (256 addresses, built in place)
stages.desc: Reads the top 8 bits of the normalized mantissa (q14..q21) as an address and XORs the polynomial coefficient bits for that address into scratch qubits; the lookup output is the same as in 9a8627. This is where the 62-qubit build first gives up a wire. 9a8627 keeps all 32 two-input AND products as temporaries and retires one per output word; here 27 of the 32 products are built in place, in the wires that become output words, and only 5 are kept as temporaries, so 39 scratch wires are live at the plateau instead of 40. It costs a few ANDs (177 Toffolis against 172), and the leftover temporaries are erased at the end in one HMR block with classically controlled Z/CZ fix-ups (Clifford).

stages.title: Early phase taps (coarse rotations)
stages.desc: Builds Boolean phase controls (exact gated quadratics of live coefficient bits) into one control qubit (q28 here; q59 and q40 in 9a8627), applies the same 22 Z_POW gates as 9a8627 (the 16 coarse rotations from 2^-18 to 2^-3 turn on that control, including the one T gate, and six on x wires) plus Clifford fix-ups, and erases each control by HMR with feedback. One wire narrower than 9a8627: fix-up parities that 9a8627 computes into fresh ancillas are kept as classical logic on measurement bits (BIT_INVERT, PUSH_CONDITION) and classically controlled CX on live wires. 92 Toffoli-class gates, 79.99 run per input on average.

stages.title: Joint coefficient (front) decoder
stages.desc: mrmeows' frozen block that synthesizes the nine missing output directions of the coefficient decoder from the address, in the live physical wire frame. One window inside it (window S1) was re-synthesised by busyaprime: 25 AND gates instead of 30, so 33 Toffolis here instead of 38. CX-heavy, with 17 independent X-basis measurements whose phase kickback is repaired in the next stage. Same gate sequence as 9a8627 here, on relabelled wires.

stages.title: Front decoder phase repair
stages.desc: About 1,700 consecutive conditional CZ/Z gates (all conditioned on measurement bits) cancel the phase kickback of the front decoder measurements: a pure-Clifford phase-repair block of rank 256 over the address. Same gate sequence as 9a8627 here, on relabelled wires.

stages.title: Polynomial arithmetic, first block
stages.desc: First arithmetic segment after the decoder: dense Toffoli+HMR activity that begins combining the decoded coefficients with the low mantissa bits. yoyobar's own candidate edits four places here (ops 21333-21635): in each, three ANDs into one target become two ANDs plus CX, one Toffoli fewer per place. 68 Toffolis here against 87 in 9a8627.

stages.title: Second CX-dominated block (lookup / history caches)
stages.desc: Another run of affine-form lookups with ~7 Toffolis per 250 ops, feeding the quadratic evaluation; consistent with the "history cache" idea of reusing earlier AND values through CNOT combinations. Apart from 11 CX at the start of 9a8627's version, the same gate sequence as 9a8627, on relabelled wires.

stages.title: Polynomial arithmetic, second block
stages.desc: The main adder/multiplier region: ~25 Toffolis and ~25 measurement-repaired AND uncomputations per 250 ops, with 8 of the 11 classical BIT_STORE/BIT_INVERT ops (ops 24285-24763). Produces the bits that are streamed into the fine phase rotations. Up to op 25157 the same gate sequence as 9a8627, on relabelled wires.

stages.title: Fine phase rotations (streamed)
stages.desc: Streams the low output bits through a control qubit with CSWAP and applies 26 Z_POW rotations from 2^-36 to 2^-11 turn, each followed by HMR feedback. q50 carries 21 of the 26 rotations here (q40 carries all 26 in 9a8627). Includes the one-Toffoli guard-bit phase correction F15 xor [Y1 and (e1 xor e2)], on q54, q18 and q27.

stages.title: Phase merge repair
stages.desc: Repairs the phase of the streamed control bits after the rotations (the "partial-merge" correction tail). In this circuit the stage also holds fix-up logic that 9a8627 runs on fresh ancillas: parities of measurement bits computed classically (BIT_INVERT, nested PUSH/POP_CONDITION) and linear forms XORed onto live wires under classical control, then undone. That makes it 2,850 ops against 865 in 9a8627. Its 78 Toffoli-class gates sit mostly in measurement-conditioned blocks: 6 run per input on average.

stages.title: Late arithmetic with CCZ phase terms
stages.desc: Dense Toffoli/CCZ/HMR region (about 280 Toffolis) with many X gates and nested PUSH/POP_CONDITION blocks; the measurement-conditioned non-Clifford corrections of the arithmetic live here. This circuit adds 20 classically conditioned Z_POW rotations here (T, S and their inverses) as part of its fix-up logic.

stages.title: Third CX-dominated block
stages.desc: Another long affine-form block (about 60 Toffolis) preparing inputs for the late curvature/normalization stage. Same gate sequence as 9a8627 here, on relabelled wires.

stages.title: Late curvature and normalization stream
stages.desc: Recycles caches with HMR+R pairs and runs the late curvature products and sequential normalization decoder before the final phase-retirement stage.

stages.title: Retained-seed phase retirement
stages.desc: A single 7,000-op pure Clifford block (CZ/Z/NEG conditioned on measurement bits) that retires the ten retained derivative seed bits and the pending address-dependent sign phases as sums of NEG, Z and CZ terms (quadratic truth-table rank 256). Same gate sequence as 9a8627, under a one-to-one relabelling of wires.

stages.title: Parity-product helpers
stages.desc: Tailored AND helpers that give the exact retirement order for the ten seeds with Clifford-only repairs, then are erased. 5 Toffolis here against 7 in 9a8627.

stages.title: Seed retirement, remaining phase terms
stages.desc: Continuation of the Clifford phase retirement (a long CZ/Z run) followed by CX frame restoration of the raw address wires. Unlike 9a8627, it also holds 20 Toffoli-class gates inside measurement-conditioned blocks: 2 run per input on average.

stages.title: Normalization unwind (gray-prefix decoder)
stages.desc: Rebuilds the leading-zero prefix flags from the retained count bits (two low bits measured in a Gray basis, higher bits turned into prefixes with CNOTs), uses them to run the CSWAP ladders backwards so x returns to q0..q21, then resets the last scratch qubits. Contains Ahmed Berat Özer's patch (ops 46845-46854): the controlled swap CSWAP q19 q6 q41 becomes X/CX onto the free wire q60, which equals q19·(q6 xor q41) at that point, a CX pair, and an HMR erase with CZ fix-ups; two CX q2 q60 around the earlier CSWAP q16 q2 q23 (ops 46765, 46767) feed it. One Toffoli fewer.

groups.name: x_reg
groups.role: input register "x" (little endian); holds the normalized mantissa mid-circuit, restored at the end

groups.name: x_lo
groups.role: low 14 mantissa bits, untouched through the front decoder
groups.evidence: documented (mrmeows' front-decoder interface: the low mantissa wires are untouched)

groups.name: addr
groups.role: top 8 bits of normalized mantissa = 8-bit coefficient-table address (256 entries)
groups.evidence: documented (truth tables on wires 14..19; 256 raw addresses)

groups.name: norm_ctrl
groups.evidence: inferred from op stream; documented as normalization outcomes/count bits

groups.name: norm_flags
groups.role: leading-zero prefix AND chain and an odd-shift flag (q22); erased by HMR in stage 0

groups.name: scratch
groups.role: all 40 non-input wires: coefficient bits, monomial caches, products, derivative seeds, phase controls; reused many times. There is no persistent output register: the result is the phase
groups.evidence: verifier contract (all non-x qubits scratch) + op stream

groups.name: phase_ctrl
groups.role: streamed phase-control qubits: q28 for the coarse pass, q50 for most of the fine pass

groups.name: retained_seeds
groups.role: ten retained derivative seed bits at the seed-phase-retirement stage
groups.evidence: 9a8627's documented wires, carried over by the one-to-one relabelling of the seed-retirement block

groups.name: raw_copy
groups.role: the eight raw-address copies kept at the seed-phase entry
groups.evidence: 9a8627's documented wires, carried over by op alignment of the seed-retirement stages

groups.name: guard_exp
groups.role: guard bit Y1 (q54) and exponent bits e1,e2 (q18,q27) used by the guard-bit phase correction
groups.evidence: 9a8627's documented wires, carried over by op alignment (ops 25672-25680)
